description: Issue a read request for a single member of a resource whose identifier takes an unusual textual or numeric form. The controller looks the record up in the data store by that identifier, exposes it under the resource's singular name, and renders the member view with a success status. The transcript reports the lookup performed (with the identifier used), the exposed name, the status, and the rendered body.

cases.expected_output:
store=find id=0
assign=article
status=200
body=Show HTML

store=find id=999999999999
assign=article
status=200
body=Show HTML

store=find id=café-über
assign=article
status=200
body=Show HTML
